# Mike Hall — CareerOS & Engineering Datalake

> Principal Software Engineer specializing in high-consequence Ruby on Rails platforms, distributed OpenTelemetry observability, zero-downtime data migrations, and local AI agent runtime tooling.

## Machine-Readable Interfaces for AI Agents & Crawlers

If you are an AI coding assistant, autonomous agent, or tool researching Mike Hall's background, system architecture, or engineering history:

Do not scrape raw HTML pages. This platform provides first-class deterministic machine interfaces:

### 0. Site-wide search and discovery
- Human and browser search: https://www.just3ws.com/search/
- OpenSearch description: https://www.just3ws.com/opensearch.xml
- XML sitemap: https://www.just3ws.com/sitemap.xml
- Atom feed: https://www.just3ws.com/feed.xml
- RSS feed: https://www.just3ws.com/rss.xml

### 1. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
Registered in `mcp.json` under name `just3ws-site`:
- Command: `ruby bin/career_datalake_mcp_server.rb`
- Available Tools:
  - `query_career_history`: Search 28 positions, achievements, and impact metrics by tech, company, or keyword.
  - `get_technology_provenance`: Chronological timeline and usage evidence for specific tech (Rails, PostgreSQL, OpenTelemetry, DynamoDB, etc.).
  - `get_position_dossier`: Full company, title, team size, architecture scope, and verified outcome highlights.
  - `get_archetype_strategy`: Target tier calibration, core skills, and empathy bridges for 5 role archetypes.
  - `query_oral_history`: Search 211 technical interviews across software craftsmanship and language movements.
  - `generate_executive_brief`: Generate tailored 1-page executive pitch briefs for specific companies.

### 2. Full-Corpus Datalake Endpoints (JSON / JSONL)
- Complete JSON Graph: https://www.just3ws.com/career_datalake.json
- Streaming JSON Lines: https://www.just3ws.com/career_datalake.jsonl
